decision_rule: Do not promote raw wheel, vparallel, or a new actor profile unless existing M146 ambiguous H1 pairs are resolved by target-aligned deployable signals rather than just any large extra-channel distance.
failure_criteria: audit consumes M146 pairs but does not deterministically reconstruct matching observations
resolution is judged only by a single seed
raw wheel or vparallel is promoted despite weak target alignment
non-deployable fields such as mu, slip ratio, tire force, TTC, path error, or oracle labels enter actor-like profile inputs
hypothesis: M146 H1 ambiguous pairs may be separated by current deployable P0 cues or wheel proxies, but separation alone may not be target-aligned enough to justify a new actor input.
success_criteria: M146 exported ambiguous pairs are evaluated across at least three seeds
P0, raw wheel, vparallel, and extra-only candidate distances are reported separately
feature-distance resolution is distinguished from target-aligned evidence
actor input contract remains free of oracle and non-deployable fields
the next ambiguity-mining decision is recorded
